series_start_reason: 2012Q1 is the earliest quarter Merck KGaA's own documents available on emdgroup.com print as a product-level Erbitux figure: the Q1 2012 interim report's 'Merck Serono | Major products by region' table prints Erbitux 213.6. The investor page lists reports from 2014 on; the 2012 and 2013 interim reports were fetched from the same /content/dam paths (which redirect to /investors/...). Reports for 2011 and earlier (tried: 2011-Q1 and 2011-Q2 under Report, Quarterly-Statement and Interim-Report names) return 404, and the 2012 reports print a 2011 comparative only for Q3 2011 (EUR 218 million, prose), so no contiguous 2011 run exists and nothing earlier is spliced in. From 2018Q1 the line is the 'thereof: Erbitux' row of the Healthcare net sales table; 2012Q1-2017Q4 are the same Erbitux total as the regional Erbitux table's Total row (EUR million, North America nil), whose 2016-2017 values equal the prior-year columns of the 2018 reports (for example 2017Q3 207 in the Q3 2018 report and 853 for 2017 in the full-year 2018 report).
indication_area: Oncology (metastatic colorectal cancer; head and neck cancer)
revenue_scope: Merck KGaA's net sales of Erbitux (Healthcare business sector, 'thereof: Erbitux' line); Merck KGaA markets Erbitux outside the U.S. and Canada
geography: Worldwide excluding the U.S. and Canada (Merck KGaA's territory); includes Japan

approval_evidence.quote: ERBITUX CETUXIMAB 100mg/VIAL VIAL; INTRAVENOUS ... Approval Date(s) and History, Letters, Labels, Reviews for BLA 125084 ... 02/12/2004 ORIG-1 Approval

notes: Scope is Merck KGaA's own Erbitux net sales (EUR), outside the U.S. and Canada: Lilly's 10-Q (for example the quarter ended June 30, 2014) states 'A development and license agreement grants Merck exclusive rights to market Erbitux outside of the U.S. and Canada', and the North America column of Merck KGaA's regional Erbitux tables (2012-2019 reports) is a dash. Japan is co-commercialized with Lilly and BMS and is inside Merck KGaA's figure: the 2014 annual report (note on the co-commercialization agreement for Erbitux in Japan, agreement dated October 2007) says the division distributes the product and books the sales for the collaboration (EUR 113.2 million in 2014), and full promotional responsibility for Japan was to transfer to Merck KGaA as of May 1, 2015 (the same note). Sources by period: 2012Q1-2014Q3 the quarterly report's regional Erbitux table (label first, one decimal); 2013Q1 and 2013Q4 the prior-year block of the Q4 2014 financial-statements workbook (the 2013 Q1 report is not on the site and the 2013 full-year report prints no fourth-quarter figure); 2014Q4 the current-year block of that workbook; 2015Q1-Q3 the quarterly report's key-product chart or narrative (whole millions; the regional table of the same report prints 205.3, 232.8, 223.2); 2015Q4, 2016Q4 and 2017Q4 the Erbitux commentary of the Q4 earnings presentation ('Sales increase to EUR 237m', 'decrease to EUR 222m', 'decrease to EUR 215 m'); 2016Q1-Q3 and 2017Q1, Q3 the quarterly press release; 2017Q2 the interim report narrative; 2018Q1-2026Q2 the Healthcare net sales table. In the 2015-2017 reports the regional table prints the quarter as a Total row (EUR million) directly above the label line, which the staged-row checker cannot read as a labelled row, so the figure is cited where the same document prints it with the product name in front; the values agree with the Total rows (2016Q1 207, Q2 232, Q3 219, 2017Q1 218, Q2 213, Q3 207). Fourth quarters: 2012Q4 is the full-year 887.4 less the three quarters (year_to_date_less_reported_quarters); 2018Q4-2022Q4 are the full year less the January-September row of the Q3 report (annual_less_reported_first_nine_months; the 2021 first three quarters sum to 725 against a printed 726, rounding); 2023Q4-2025Q4 are the full year less the three quarterly rows, because the 2023-2025 Q3 reports print no January-September row (year_to_date_less_reported_quarters). Cross-checks: 2012 quarters sum to the printed 887.4; 2013 to 882.2 (882.27); 2014 to 903.7; 2015 to 898.7 (898 from whole-million quarters); 2016 to the 2016 annual report's 880; 2017 to 853. Alternative lines that were found and not used because their scope changes or they do not run to date: (1) Eli Lilly prints a worldwide 'Erbitux' revenue line (net royalties and collaboration revenue plus product supplied to partners, later North America net product sales) in 10-Qs and 10-Ks from 2010Q4 to 2024Q3/FY2024 (10-K FY2024 total 627.4; the 2025 10-Qs carry no Erbitux row); Lilly's June 30, 2015 10-Q dates the change in what the line contains: 'In April 2015, we and BMS agreed to modify the existing arrangement to provide for the transfer to us of BMS's commercialization rights with respect to Erbitux in North America with the transition expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 2015', so Lilly's line is not one scope across its span. (2) Bristol-Myers Squibb printed a quarterly Erbitux line in its earnings-release exhibits from 2011; from 2016 on its Q3 2016 release prints a dash for the current quarter and 167 / 501 as the prior-year quarter / nine months.
search_log: Listed every Lilly filing via data.sec.gov submissions (all forms, CIK 59478) and took the 8-K item 2.02 filings, 10-Q and 10-K (and their /A forms) filed 2011-01-01 to 2026-08-05 (137 filings); downloaded every .htm document in each filing (exhibits, main document and XBRL R pages) and counted occurrences of Erbitux, Synjardy, Glyxambi, Rezvoglar and Relprevv (work/scan.py, work/rows.py). Table rows beginning 'Erbitux' exist in Lilly's filings 2015-2024 (US / outside US / total); pre-2015 10-Qs carry a 'Total revenue' row in the Erbitux collaboration note and the release prose gives the quarter. Lilly's line is Lilly's revenue and changes composition in 2015 (see notes), so it was not chosen.

Listed every Bristol-Myers Squibb filing (CIK 14272, 127 filings 2011-01-27 to 2026-07-30; 67 of them name Erbitux, last on 2022-02-09) and extracted rows beginning Erbitux: BMS prints a quarterly Erbitux line to 2015 and a dash from its Q3 2016 release.

Downloaded 90 listed Merck KGaA (emdgroup.com reports-and-financials page) quarterly/annual reports and financial statements 2014-2026 (work/emd_urls.txt, work/emd/) and extracted every page whose text contains 'thereof: Erbitux' or 'of which: Erbitux' with pdftotext, then re-read those pages with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) for the quoted figures (work/emd3.py, work/emd3.out).

2018Q1-2026Q2 each have a quarter row ('thereof: Erbitux') and each Q2/Q3/Q4 report also a January-June / January-September (2018-2022 only) / full-year row; 2023-2025 Q3 reports print no January-September row.

2014Q1-2017Q4 Merck KGaA reports re-read for the regional Erbitux tables (work/e15.py, work/e15.out): every quarter 2014Q1-2017Q3 prints a Total EUR million row for Erbitux (2014Q1-Q3 label-first, e.g. 'Erbitux 209.2 122.9 - 54.4 31.9'; 2014Q4 onward the Total row sits directly above the 'Erbitux Organic growth in %' line, e.g. 2016Q1 207, 2016Q2 232, 2016Q3 219, 2017Q1 218, 2017Q2 213, 2017Q3 207; full years 903.7, 898.7, 880, 853). The earlier statement that no contiguous table run exists before 2018Q1 was wrong and is withdrawn.

FY check: for 2018-2025 the four quarters sum to the printed full-year line by construction of Q4; the 2018-2022 Q1+Q2+Q3 sums equal the printed nine-month rows except 2021 (725 vs 726 printed, rounding).

Fetching emdgroup.com requires a browser User-Agent (the project User-Agent gets the connection dropped); the verifier run needs SEC_CONTACT set to a browser UA. Cited URLs are the emdgroup.com content/dam paths that were downloaded.

Because the staged-row checker needs the product name before the figure on one line, each 2014Q4-2017Q4 quarter was matched against the issuer's own press release, earnings presentation, narrative or financial-statements workbook for that period (downloaded to work/sl/): 2014Q4 workbook row 'Erbitux' (Q4 2014 234.09; also 'Sales increase to EUR 234 m' in the Q4 2014 slides), 2015Q4 slides 'Sales increase to EUR 237m', 2016Q1-Q3 press releases, 2016Q4 slides 'Sales decrease to EUR 222m', 2017Q1 and Q3 press releases, 2017Q2 report narrative, 2017Q4 slides 'Sales decrease to EUR 215 m'. Press-release and slide figures are whole millions and equal the Total rows of the same period's regional tables.

Extended back to 2012: the 2012-Q1..Q4 and 2013-Q2..Q4 reports exist at emdgroup.com/investors/reports-and-financials/earnings-materials/<yyyy-qn>/us/<yyyy>-Q<n>-Report-US.pdf (the investor page index lists 2014 onward). Their 'Merck Serono | Major products by region' tables print Erbitux 213.6 (Q1 2012), 225.7, 224.3, full year 887.4; 2013: 215.0 (Q2), 222.6 (Q3), full year 882.2. The 2013 Q1 report URL returns 404 under 2013-Q1-Report-US, -Report, -Quarterly-Statement-US, -Interim-Report-US and -Quarterly-Report-US; 2013Q1 and 2013Q4 are taken from the Q4 2014 financial-statements workbook (prior-year block: 221.66 and 223.01); the Q1 2014 report's prose 'Q1 2013: EUR 222 million' agrees. 2011 reports (Q1, Q2 under three names each) return 404; 2012 reports give a 2011 comparative only for Q3 (EUR 218 million), so the series starts at 2012Q1.

The checker's hand reads were repeated: 2018Q1 200, 2018Q2 203, 2018Q4 201 (816 less 615), 2020Q3 217, 2020Q4 255 (891 less 636), 2021Q2 273, 2021Q3 233, 2021Q4 261 (987 less 726), 2022Q2 258, 2023Q3 271, 2023Q4 244 (1,025 less 781), 2024Q3 301, 2025Q3 310, 2025Q4 273 (1,176 less 903), 2026Q2 303 agree with the CSV. The 2023Q4, 2024Q4 and 2025Q4 derivation label was set to year_to_date_less_reported_quarters (a label the sourcing prompt names) because no January-September row is printed in those years; the quote lists every input.
